chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

When the Day of Resurrection comes, the servant will be called; the first thing he will be questioned about is the prayer. If he has brought it complete, [he will be forgiven]; otherwise, he will be thrown into the Fire.
ai.seo_question: What is the first thing a person will be questioned about on the Day of Resurrection according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him) establishes the five daily prayers as the primary criterion for divine judgment, highlighting their status as the first deed scrutinized on the Day of Resurrection. This emphasis underscores the Shia scholarly view that *Salat* serves as the foundational pillar of faith, where its completeness ensures salvation while its deficiency leads directly to the Hellfire, reflecting the gravity of maintaining ritual purity and consistency.
